statement: Two copies of C(3,4)^{(x)2} degenerate (first order in eps, polynomial of degree 2) to T_2^{(x)2}, T_2 = two rectangles C(2,2) sharing X.  One copy is impossible (Koszul).  Consequence: lambda(T_2) <= sqrt(2) lambda(C(3,4)) for every tensor character.
construction: ell(tau) = 4 - j - k on single-factor terms (zero exactly on the two cross terms); L = ell(tau1) ell(tau2) = 16 - 4(j1+j2) - 4(k1+k2) + 2 j1 j2 + 2 k1 k2 - x1 x2 (additive); w = 1/L on retained terms is rank one; copies scaled by rho sigma tau (1 + eps alpha)(1 + eps beta)(1 + eps gamma) and -rho sigma tau, divided by eps.
